annotation.title_clean: Decision No 2/2003 of the Committee established under the Agreement between the European Community and the Swiss Confederation on mutual recognition in relation to conformity assessment on the listing of a conformity assessment body under the sectoral chapter for medical devices
annotation.title_en: Decision No 2/2003 of the Committee established under the Agreement between the European Community and the Swiss Confederation on mutual recognition in relation to conformity assessment on the listing of a conformity assessment body under the sectoral chapter for medical devices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Committee established under the EC–Swiss Agreement on mutual recognition in relation to conformity assessment
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union L 323
annotation.summary_en: 2003 EC–Switzerland joint Committee decision adding a conformity assessment body to the medical devices list under the mutual recognition agreement. The listed body is responsible for class IIb male condoms under Directive 93/42/EEC. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds a named conformity assessment body to the EU list under the medical devices chapter of Annex I.
Decision effective from the later signature date.
Listed body covers class IIb male condoms under Directive 93/42/EEC Annex IV.
Adopted under Articles 10(4)(a) and 11 of the EC–Swiss MRA.
